Hand-painted matte, not photoreal, not green grassland.

Anonymous texture only, hand-painted matte, not photoreal, not green.

prompts.notes: image_gen produced JPEG with no alpha. Tiles are converted to luminance structure; hue is discarded (contract 7). Ridges sit on a magenta key field and are keyed like tools/cloud-atlas-build.mjs. Tiling is a 50% offset-heal of the centre cross (no mirror). A first base (4.jpg, large mauve kidney) tiled as a motif and was discarded. A first detail attempt that read as pebbles was discarded (2.jpg / 8.jpg).
